name: player_ai_rebuild_synthetic_path_to_node_if_far
description: AINet::AiRebuildSyntheticPathToNodeIfFar creates a transient negative-index AINetNode and probe fan when the AI drifts too far from the current path node.
known_limits: Functional target covers the near-distance no-op gate and far-distance synthetic node/probe fan allocation path. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent AI mode-2 player cluster.
